module: Crawl editor mouse helper: on each updateMouseInfo call, computes the camera-mouse ray, the raycast on the scene (forest disabled during the cast) and the left button click/hold/release states. The other crawlEditor files read the result via getMouseInfo().
notes: Fields of the mouseInfo table: camPos, ray, rayDir, rayCast, valid, down, hold, up, closestNodeHovered, and _downPos/_downNormal, _holdPos/_holdNormal, _upPos/_upNormal (vec3 from rayCast.pos and rayCast.normal).
down/hold/up are forced to false when the raycast hits nothing; otherwise they are also false if imgui captures the mouse (WantCaptureMouse).
getMouseInfo() returns nil as long as updateMouseInfo has never been called.

updateMouseInfo.desc: Updates the mouseInfo table (camera position, mouse ray, raycast, left button states). Disables then re-enables forest collision around the raycast.

returns.desc: mouseInfo, or nil before the first updateMouseInfo
